name: application-auth-card-shell
title: Auth Card Shell
description: Centered auth layout shell with a logo mark, heading, a form slot for sign-in/sign-up fields, and a footer slot for the flow-switch link.
useWhen: Building a sign-in, sign-up, or password-reset page that needs consistent centered-card chrome.
You want one shell reused across every auth screen (logo, heading, footer switch link) while swapping the form fields inside.
Pairing with Two-Factor Setup or Magic Link Sent State as the content for a specific step in a larger auth flow.
avoidWhen: You need a generic content card with no auth-specific header/footer conventions — use Card instead.
The page needs a split layout with marketing imagery alongside the form — this shell is a single centered card, not a two-column page layout.
responsiveBehavior: The card has a fixed max width and centers itself; it should sit inside a full-viewport-height flex/grid container so it stays vertically centered on any screen size.
accessibility: The heading is a real <h1>, establishing the page's primary landmark for screen readers even though the shell itself renders no <main>.
The form slot is left entirely to the consumer, so real <form>, <label>, and field associations come from whatever is passed as children.
The footer switch link should always be reachable by keyboard since it's the primary way to move to the other auth flow (e.g. sign-in to sign-up).

variants.title: Auth Card Shell
variants.description: A sign-in card: logo mark, 'Sign in to your account' heading and subtitle, an email + password form with a Forgot password link and Sign in button, and a footer Sign up link.
accessibility: The example form fields use real <label for> associations; replace them with your own validated form as needed.

variants.title: Auth Card Shell (Dark)
variants.description: The same sign-in card shell adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Card, input, and link contrast remain legible against the dark page background.
